close_reason: Transport handoff contract is pinned by transport_contract_test: positions, producer/resume shape sharing, entry captures, value shapes, lane facts, CallableId/BoundaryId facts, and CodegenSeam facts are asserted. Remaining Trash* consumers are inventoried on fz-hwn.19.2-.5.
description:
Goal
Before cutting consumers over, verify the fz-hwn.20 TransportPlan handoff is complete at the consumer seams that fz-hwn.19 will touch. This ticket does not design the model; it proves the existing plan facts are sufficient to replace old consumer-local authorities.

Required contract
Consumer-facing tests must read or observe TransportPlan facts for: executable inputs, returns, delivered resumes, entry captures, body values, continuation payloads, lane facts, CallableId facts, BoundaryId contracts, and seam-specific codegen facts. Producer return and consumer resume must share one ShapeId. Codegen repr must be asserted as a seam fact, not shape.

Worked-example contract
The worked example from outline.md remains the proof target: a tuple-field return containing a direct callable is transported without tuple or heap closure allocation; the producer return and consumer resume use the same ShapeId; direct callable invocation reads CallableId target/capture facts; an escaped callable publishes a BoundaryId contract; codegen repr is a seam fact.

Removal inventory
Use the fz-hwn.20.6 inventory to identify which Trash* helpers and recursive mirrors each consumer seam will lose. Do not add compatibility helpers. Tests that still assert TrashRuntimeValueLayout, TrashDeliveredShape, TrashNativeDemandAbi, local ArgRepr derivation, or boundary-return projection as authority must be rewritten or deleted before the seam cutover begins.

Checks
Targeted compiler2 transport tests pass against the independent TransportPlan. rg inventory shows remaining old-world assertions are either removed or explicitly tied to a later fz-hwn.19 cutover ticket.
title: Transport cutover: accept the flow-graph handoff and pin consumer contracts
